plain: Mike Masters, a guest on a podcast about the idea that aliens might be humans from the future, recalls his college days at Ohio University. He says he remembers the exact moment, standing behind a campus building called Morton Hall, when a little voice in his head told him that maybe he should explore the question a certain way. He tells it as the moment his thinking on the subject began.
